card.name: Digits in unit sizes after a count
card.fires_on: A digit (or the space before it) inside a unit size that follows a small count word such as two or three, as in 'two 150 mg tablets' or 'eight 38-centimeter guns'.

modes.label: Tablet or injection strength
modes.description: A digit inside the strength number after 'two' or 'three' in dosing instructions.
modes.example: Loading dose: 300 mg (two 1<<5>>0 mg injections) by subcutaneous

modes.label: Gun or drive size
modes.description: A digit inside a size number after a count in non-medical text about guns or drives.
modes.example: main battery of eight 3<<8>>-centimeter guns in four twin turrets

card.plain: It lights up on the digits of a strength or size that comes right after a count, like two 150 mg tablets.
